propositions: The code-review extension seam does not dynamically fan in net-new LLM-backed project criteria into Pass 1 discovery
Project criterion routing is incomplete: eval surface resolution and Pass-3 repository-aware routing do not currently support code-review project criteria

Four-phase review boundaries are being violated when criteria move severity, disposition, or fix instructions between phases, collapsing the productive tension between Pass 1 (critical) and Pass 2 (generous)
The generic integration defect prevents logical project criterion IDs from being mapped to validator-safe physical IDs and routed through all four passes consistently

A balanced eval corpus and live Gerrit dogfood evidence are needed to validate that project.review-phase-boundaries distinguishes phase-compliant findings from cross-phase violations before any blocking is enabled
